quotes.text: Contract reference: CW-2025-0417-CIV
THIS AGREEMENT is made between AL-MURJAN INFRASTRUCTURE CONTRACTING COMPANY ("the Contractor") and RIDGEWAY CIVIL ENGINEERING LLC ("the Subcontractor")
The Subcontractor shall submit a payment application monthly.

Each application shall list every item measured, stating the item code, the date of execution, the Site zone, the ground classification where applicable, the quantity, the unit, the built-up rate applied and the resulting amount.
For Clauses 19, 31, 32, 44 and P6 the Site is divided into the work areas below. A work area may extend into more than one zone.
S-01 Platform North Northern half of the industrial platform

discrepancies: No discrepancy in labels or pages. Ambiguity (not resolved): no clause expressly requires an application header to carry the contract reference or the issuer name; the rule infers this from the p1 particulars (reference CW-2025-0417-CIV; Subcontractor RIDGEWAY CIVIL ENGINEERING LLC) and Cl.40 ('The Subcontractor shall submit'). Cl.42 requires each item to state the 'Site zone', not the work area; the work areas S-01..S-05 on p20 are defined 'For Clauses 19, 31, 32, 44 and P6', which does not list Cl.40 or Cl.42. The validation cases (reference variant kept as discrepancy; issuer exact match) are audit-handling choices the contract does not address.

quotes.text: Each application shall state the period of the Works it covers, being the first and last day on which any measured item included in it was executed.
no item shall be included in an application whose stated period does not include the day on which the work was executed.
Period in relation to a payment application, the span of days stated in it under Clause 40.

discrepancies: Ambiguity (not resolved): the validation cases list scenarios without stating outcomes; the text supports that a line on the boundary day is inside the period (a stated period 'includes' its first and last day), a line one day outside is barred by Cl.41, and a period wider than the first/last executed day departs from Cl.40's definition ('being the first and last day on which any measured item included in it was executed'). The contract does not state the consequence of a wrongly stated (too wide) period.

quotes.text: Commencement date 05 January 2025
Date for completion 27 September 2025
The Term as let ran from 5 January 2025 to 27 September 2025. As twice extended it runs from 5 January 2025 to 30 September 2026.

The Date for Completion stated in the Form of Subcontract is extended to 31 March 2026 (extension of time, 185 days). The Date of Possession is unchanged. Work executed on or before the extended Date for Completion is measurable and payable under this Subcontract; work executed after it is not.

The Date for Completion stated in the Form of Subcontract is extended to 30 September 2026 (second extension of time, 183 days). The Date of Possession is unchanged. Work executed on or before the extended Date for Completion is measurable and payable under this Subcontract; work executed after it is not.

discrepancies: Parameter values match print: commencement '05 January 2025' (p1, also '5 January 2025' p38); A2 completion '30 September 2026' (p42 2.1, p38). Validation 2026-09-30 measurable and 2026-10-01 not measurable follow from A2 2.1 ('on or before ... measurable ... after it is not'). Ambiguity (not resolved): no provision expressly says work executed before the Commencement Date is not measurable; the 2025-01-04 case relies on the Term start (p38 'runs from 5 January 2025') and the p1 commencement date, while A1 1.1/A2 2.1 only exclude work after the extended Date for Completion.

quotes.text: An application covers a period which has closed. No application shall be submitted before the last day of the period it states,
An application shall be submitted within 21 days of the end of the period it covers.

discrepancies: Parameter value 21 matches print ('within 21 days of the end of the period it covers'). Ambiguity (not resolved): the clause does not state how the 21 days are counted (whether day 1 is the day after the period end); the 'day 21 inside / day 22 outside' cases assume counting from the day after the last day of the period. 'Same day as period end allowed' follows from 'No application shall be submitted before the last day', though the first sentence ('covers a period which has closed') could be read as requiring the period to be over.

quotes.text: The items listed below are not payable in any valuation until the record named against them has been delivered to the Engineer. Each record bears a reference from the series shown, and that reference is quoted against the line in the Application (Clause 47A).

Where Schedule 5 states that a record is required for an item, the item is not payable in any valuation until that record has been delivered to the Engineer. The absence of a required record is a breach of this Clause and not merely a want of corroboration.

A record required by Schedule 5 shall identify the work area, the date, the item code and the quantity, and shall be signed by the Subcontractor's foreman and countersigned by the Engineer's representative.
Each record bears a reference from the series stated in Schedule 5 against the item it evidences, and that reference is quoted against the line in the Application.
A record required by Schedule 5 may be delivered in electronic form provided it bears both signatures required by Clause 47.

Where an item requiring a record under Schedule 5 has been included in a valuation without that record, the amount shall be deducted from the next valuation together with any retention released upon it.
Where Schedule 5 makes a test certificate a condition of payment, no valuation shall include the item until the certificate has been delivered.
Pressure pipework shall be tested in accordance with the Specification and the certificate delivered before the pipework is included in a valuation.

discrepancies: Schedule 5 (p27) lists exactly 17 items (A.12.030, A.14.010, B.21.020, B.21.030, C.31.020, D.41.010, E.51.010, A.12.040, A.16.010, B.21.040, C.32.030, C.35.010, D.41.040, E.51.030, B.23.010, E.52.010, B.23.020), matching the scope. Ambiguity (not resolved): the contract does not say how an 'underscore placeholder' signature or a reference with no delivered file is to be treated; these cases rest on Cl.46/47 ('delivered', 'signed ... and countersigned'). 'Non-Sch 5 item with blank ref is not a breach' is an inference from the reference requirement being tied to Schedule 5 items only; no clause states it expressly. P23 gives the consequence for a record-less item already valued (deduction from the next valuation), which the rule statement does not mention.

quotes.text: A record required by Schedule 5 shall identify the work area, the date, the item code and the quantity, and shall be signed by the Subcontractor's foreman and countersigned by the Engineer's representative.
A site record is written by the person who carried out the work and is not required to adopt the wording of the Bill of Quantities.
A record that evidences a week records each day worked; a week is measurable only where the record shows work on not fewer than five days of that week.
The record is written in the words of the person who did the work and does not repeat the description in Schedule 1.
A record covering a week records each day worked. A week is measurable only where the record shows work on not fewer than five days of that week (Clause 47A).

discrepancies: Cl.47 lists the particulars a record must identify as 'the work area, the date, the item code and the quantity'; it names the item code, not an 'activity', and none of Cl.47, 47A or the Sch 5 note mentions the unit, so the 'unit sense' element of the title has no express basis in the cited text. The cited text requires a record to identify these particulars but does not expressly state that they must agree with the line or what follows from a disagreement. Ambiguity (not resolved): the validation cases (DW week crossing a month boundary; record date differing from line date treated as mismatch, not duplicate) are not addressed by the text; 47A/Sch 5 note only say a weekly record records each day worked and a week needs work on not fewer than five days, and that record wording need not follow the Bill of Quantities.

quotes.text: Where an item is measured by the hour, a Chargeable Hour is an hour of attendance other than the first hour of that attendance. The site record states the hours attended; the quantity measured is one hour fewer.

Where an item is measured against a joint survey, a measured quantity not exceeding the surveyed quantity by more than 2 per cent is payable as measured. A measured quantity exceeding the surveyed quantity by more than that is payable at the surveyed quantity only.
A record that evidences a week records each day worked; a week is measurable only where the record shows work on not fewer than five days of that week.
Items marked as surveyed in Schedule 1 are measured only against a joint survey sheet signed by both parties. The quantity measured shall be the quantity on the survey sheet exactly.
Part 6 — Surveyed items The following items are measured only against a joint survey sheet signed by both parties (Clause 33).
Setting out is measured under item E.52.010 by chainage band and only against a joint survey signed by both parties.
Wastage on reinforcement is deemed included. The quantity measured is the theoretical mass on the approved bar schedule (Clause 33).

discrepancies: Parameter values match print: first hour excluded = 1 ('other than the first hour ... one hour fewer', 6A p32); weekly minimum = 5 ('not fewer than five days', 47A p33 and Sch 5 note p27); survey tolerance = 2 ('2 per cent', 33A p32). Validation arithmetic is consistent with 33A: 102.00% does not exceed by more than 2 per cent (payable as measured); 102.01% does (surveyed quantity only); 1 hour attended less one = 0; 4 days < five. Not supported by the cited contract text: the case 'claim below record is not increased' is not stated in any cited provision; Cl.33 says 'The quantity measured shall be the quantity on the survey sheet exactly', which on its face does not address a lower claim. 'guideline check 5' could not be verified: reading /home/user/majedzahrani3/invoice-auditing-level-2/civilwork/guidelines/INVOICE_AUDIT_GUIDELINES.md was refused by the permission system, so any claim resting on it is unverified (not contradicted). Ambiguity (not resolved): Cl.33 ('quantity on the survey sheet exactly') and 33A (2 per cent tolerance, payable as measured) state different measures for surveyed items; P18 makes the reinforcement quantity 'the theoretical mass on the approved bar schedule (Clause 33)' although B.23.010/B.23.020 are Part 6 surveyed items.

quotes.text: Each item in Schedule 1 states the unit in which it is measured. No item shall be measured in any other unit, and a quantity presented in a unit other than that stated shall be rejected in its entirety rather than converted.
Rates are per unit stated. No item may be measured in a unit other than the one shown (Clause 26).
A.14.020 Backfilling to trenches with selected arisings m3 750 22.40

discrepancies: Validation 'A.14.020 billed in no. rejected in full' is consistent with print: Schedule 1 states A.14.020 in m3 (p17, not a cited page, read to check the unit), so 'no.' is another unit and Cl.26 requires rejection in its entirety. Ambiguity (not resolved): the case 'record synonym cube does not change a correct invoice unit' is not addressed by Cl.26 or the Sch 1 note; it rests on reading Cl.26 as applying to the quantity presented in the application, with 47A (p33: a record 'is not required to adopt the wording of the Bill of Quantities') as possible support; the contract does not say so expressly.

quotes.text: Trench depth shall be measured from the existing ground level at the centre line of the trench to the invert of the pipe, and shall determine which of items A.12.020, A.12.030 and A.12.040 applies. Where a single trench spans two depth bands each part shall be measured separately.
A.12.020 Excavation in trench, depth not exceeding 2 m m3 2,675 34.80
A.12.030 Excavation in trench, depth 2 m to 4 m m3 575 47.60
A.12.040 Excavation in trench, depth exceeding 4 m m3 900 69.20
C.32.010 Precast manhole, 1200 mm diameter, depth to 3 m no. 116 1,860.00
Rates are per unit stated. No item may be measured in a unit other than the one shown (Clause 26).

discrepancies: Supported by P13 (p13) and Sch 1 (pp17-19): trench depth decides A.12.020/030/040 and a trench spanning two depth bands is measured in parts. Not found in the cited contract text: 'unresolvable identification stays unresolved' and the case 'two candidate items -> unresolved, never cheapest'; no cited contract provision addresses an unresolvable item identification. These appear to rest on 'guideline check 6', which could not be verified: reading /home/user/majedzahrani3/invoice-auditing-level-2/civilwork/guidelines/INVOICE_AUDIT_GUIDELINES.md was refused by the permission system (unverified, not contradicted). Ambiguity (not resolved): the printed bands overlap at exactly 2 m ('depth not exceeding 2 m' for A.12.020 and 'depth 2 m to 4 m' for A.12.030 both include 2 m); 4 m falls in A.12.030 ('2 m to 4 m') and not A.12.040 ('exceeding 4 m'). Pages 18 and 19 contain Series B-E items and the Sch 1 unit note, which bear on identification generally but not on trench depth.

quotes.text: The Subcontract is to be read with the instruments below, in the order issued. Each takes effect on its own effective date and governs work executed on or after it; nothing in an instrument reopens work already measured at the rate then payable.

A rate stated in the Bill of Quantities is the rate payable only until an instrument substitutes another for it. Pricing a measured quantity therefore requires the date on which the work was executed, not the date of the payment application.
B.23.010 High-yield reinforcement bar, cut, tonne 4,120.00 4,385.00 2025-05-01
Where work is executed in a month later than the last month stated below, the rate last published applies until it is superseded.
September 2025 220.50
E.54.010 Temporary haul road, maintained, p week 876.00 948.00 2025-10-01
B.23.010 High-yield reinforcement bar, cut, tonne 4,385.00 4,450.00 2025-10-01
D.41.020 Dense bitumen macadam binder cours m2 220.50 228.00 2025-12-01
Work executed on or before the extended Date for Completion is measurable and payable under this Subcontract; work executed after it is not.
Reference CW-2025-0417-CIV/A3. Issued 12 May 2026 and taking effect 1 November 2025.

Where this instrument and an earlier instrument both state a rate or a discount for the same item, the later governs work executed on or after its effective date, and the earlier governs work executed before it.

discrepancies: Validation cases agree with print: B.23.010 is 4,120.00 in Sch 1 (p17), 4,385.00 from 2025-05-01 (S1), 4,450.00 from 2025-10-01 (A1), so 2025-04-30 = 4,120.00, 2025-05-01 and 2025-09-30 = 4,385.00, 2025-10-01 = 4,450.00. D.41.020 table ends September 2025 at 220.50 and the carry-forward sentence applies to October 2025 (S2 substitutes 228.00 only from 2025-12-01, showing 220.50 as rate previously payable). E.54.010: A1 948.00 from 2025-10-01 covers March 2026; A2 table gives April 2026 976.00; October 2026 is after the extended Date for Completion 30 September 2026. Note: A1's instrument effective date is 2025-09-28 (p38/p40) but its item rates are effective 2025-10-01. Ambiguity (not resolved): A3 (issued 2026-05-12, effective 2025-11-01) requires already-certified work to be re-measured at the substituted rates with a single adjustment, whereas the SoV says 'nothing in an instrument reopens work already measured at the rate then payable'; and the footer's 'the later governs' does not say whether 'later' means later issued or later effective when an instrument is retroactive (A3).

quotes.text: The items below are priced by reference to the Site Materials Index, base 100.00 at 5 January 2025 (Clause 29A). The rate stated in Schedule 1 for these items is a base rate and is not payable as it stands.
C.31.010 uPVC drainage pipe, 225 mm, laid and jointed 86.20 lm
D.41.030 Stone mastic asphalt surface course, 40 mm 89.40 m2

The rate for an item listed in Schedule 2A is the base rate stated in Schedule 1 multiplied by the Site Materials Index published for the calendar month in which the work was executed and divided by the base index, and rounded to the nearest halala with a half rounded to the nearer even halala. That figure is then treated as the rate for the purposes of Clause 27, and Clause 28 applies to the build-up as usual.

discrepancies: Scope matches Sch 2A (C.31.010 and D.41.030 are the only items listed). Validation arithmetic checks: 86.20 x 102.60 / 100 = 88.4412, rounded half-even to the halala = 88.44; base rate 86.20 (Sch 2A and Sch 1 p18) and May 2025 index 102.60 match print; base index is printed as 100.00. Ambiguity (not resolved): 29A rounds the indexed rate and then says 'Clause 28 applies to the build-up as usual', while Cl.28 (p6) says 'Rounding shall be applied once only' with a half halala rounded upward; the text leaves open how the two roundings interact.

quotes.text: The rate stated in Schedule 1 for the items below is in USD and is converted under Clause 26A at the rate published for the month in which the work was executed.
C.32.040 Manhole cover and frame, Class D400, bedded 423.00 no.

Where Schedule 1 states a rate in USD, the rate is converted at the rate of exchange published in Schedule 2B for the calendar month in which the work was executed, and the converted figure is rounded to the nearest halala with a half rounded to the nearer even halala. The conversion is made before any factor or uplift is applied.

discrepancies: Scope matches Sch 2B (B.23.020 38.40, B.25.010 219.00, C.32.040 423.00 USD). Validation arithmetic checks: January 2025 rate 375.00 halalas per USD = 3.75; 423.00 x 3.75 = 1586.25 (exact, no rounding needed). Half-even at an exact half halala follows from 26A. Ambiguity (not resolved): Schedule 1 (p18) prints these three rates under a column headed 'Rate (SAR)', while Sch 2B and 26A treat the Schedule 1 figure as USD; the rule follows Sch 2B/26A. 26A says the conversion is made 'before any factor or uplift'; it does not state how the converted rate interacts with the single rounding in Cl.28.
